verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents specific built-in AI features — an 'AI Editor' for creating/modifying ingestion workflows via natural language prompts and 'Sprinto AI' for automated evidence validation — which qualify as delegating narrow tasks to embedded AI. However, there's no evidence of a general-purpose conversational assistant that can be delegated arbitrary cross-platform tasks (e.g., assigning tasks, running audits, managing frameworks) via natural language. Missing for 10: a unified in-product AI assistant spanning the full platform (not just ingestion/evidence), evidence of task delegation beyond workflow editing, and independent/hands-on corroboration of these AI features working as described.
